summary: Tested 4 new research features (Cohort Compare, Feature Ablation, Retrain-From-UI, Training History) end-to-end. All 8 new backend endpoints pass pytest (13/13 total). All new /compare and /lab UI flows verified via Playwright: ablation retrains 6 models with dropped groups reflected in chart+table, retrain job kicks off, streams logs, completes in ~8s with best_model populated, history table renders 7 rows. Nav links compare/lab present. Found and FIXED one critical bug: retrain subprocess spawned via 'python -m ml.pipeline' resolved to system python3 (no joblib) instead of the venv, causing every retrain to fail immediately.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first paint; in extreme cases (100% concentrated in a single band) the bars can appear near-invisible against the axis baseline — consider adding min-bar-size or explicit y-domain [0,1]
'Δ Mean prob' is a probability delta but rendered with 'pts' suffix like the percentage-point deltas — slightly misleading unit label

action_items: (optional) Improve Compare risk-band chart rendering when a cohort has 100% concentration in one band
(optional) Migrate deprecated FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown to lifespan
critical_code_review_comments: history.py used bare 'python' in subprocess → picked up /usr/bin/python3 which lacks project deps (joblib). Fixed by switching to sys.executable so the venv interpreter is always used. Same class of bug applies anywhere subprocess.Popen(['python', ...]) is used.
Compare.jsx DiffKV: color logic assumes 'positive delta = red/bad', which is fine for CKD-rate but conceptually couples semantics into a generic component.
Lab.jsx Retrain component: pollJob uses setInterval but is not cleared on component unmount → memory leak / stale-state warning if user navigates away mid-training.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 research features fully functional. Retrain now completes in ~7-10s (small dataset). Frontend nav includes Compare + Lab links. If retesting, use pytest /app/backend/tests/ (all 13 pass). Playwright covers /lab (ablation 6 rows, retrain success, history table) and /compare (upload two CSVs → diff summary + risk chart).
rca of the issue: Retrain always failed: subprocess spawned 'python -m ml.pipeline' via PATH; supervisor's PATH resolved to /usr/bin/python3 (system Python without ML deps) rather than the /root/.venv/bin/python that runs uvicorn. Reproduce: POST /api/retrain/start then GET /api/retrain/jobs → logs show ModuleNotFoundError: joblib. Fix: use sys.executable so the current interpreter (the one running FastAPI) is used, guaranteeing access to the same site-packages.
